content.title: The Greatest Gift of Love for the Prophet ﷺ: Why Is Durood the Best Provision for Our Lives?
content.subtitle: A heartfelt devotion in search of the beloved Prophet’s ﷺ nearness and intercession
content.body:
3 Blessed Virtues of Sending Durood upon the Prophet ﷺ

  • Continuous Forgiveness from the Angels: Hazrat ‘Amir ibn Rabi‘ah (RA) said that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say during a sermon that as long as a person sends Durood upon him, the angels continue to pray for that person’s forgiveness and mercy. Therefore, it is up to the servant whether he sends more Durood or less. (Reference: Musnad Ahmad 3/445, Sunan Ibn Majah, Hadith: 907, Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaybah 6/40)

  • The Prophet’s ﷺ Intercession Becomes Certain: Hazrat Ruwayfi‘ ibn Thabit al-Ansari (RA) narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said that whoever recites the following Durood will have his intercession (Shafa‘ah) guaranteed: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَنْزِلْهُ الْمَقْعَدَ الْمُقَرَّبَ عِنْدَكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ (Reference: Al-Mu‘jam al-Kabir, Tabarani 5/4481; Majma‘ al-Zawa’id 10/254)

  • Being Closest to the Prophet ﷺ on the Day of Judgment: Hazrat ‘Abdullah ibn Mas‘ud (RA) narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said that on the Day of Judgment, the person who will be closest to him will be the one who has sent the most Durood upon him. (Reference: Jami‘ al-Tirmidhi 1/110, Hadith: 484)

The Relevance of Our 10 Million Durood Campaign

The priceless opportunity to seek the Prophet’s ﷺ nearness and intercession on the difficult Day of Judgment is something we want to bring into every Muslim home. With this intention, we are organising the 10-day “10 Million Durood Challenge.”

This campaign is a sincere effort to revive the blessed practice of sending Durood and encourage the Ummah to make it a regular part of daily life.

Take part in the initiative to send 10 million Durood. Join the campaign now: https://campaign.muslimsday.com

Some Common Questions and Answers

Q: Is setting a collective target of 10 million Durood a bid‘ah or against Shari‘ah?

Answer: In this initiative, we are simply adding together everyone’s individual counts. Durood is not being recited collectively. Each person recites Durood individually and shares their count on the website. Therefore, it remains a personal act of worship.

The target of 10 million is not associated with any special virtue. Ten million is simply a number—a milestone or target. It could have been 5 million or 20 million. There is no specific virtue in reciting exactly 10 million Durood, nor does every participant need to recite 10 million. Everyone may recite as much as they can with love, sincerity, and proper respect for the Prophet ﷺ.

The shared total may inspire others to increase their Durood. Since individual counts are not visible to others, there is, In Sha Allah, no intention of showing off or riyā’.

This initiative has also been discussed with reliable scholars. In Sha Allah, it contains no element that is contrary to Shari‘ah. Just as we use apps to make religious practice easier—such as checking prayer times, reading Seerah, or participating in Islamic quizzes—this initiative uses technology to encourage a beneficial personal act of worship.

Q: What is the main purpose of this campaign?

Answer: Its sole purpose is to revive the blessed practice of sending Durood in our daily lives and establish it as a lasting Sunnah. We hope that these 10 days of increased Durood will inspire us to continue the practice throughout our lives.
